description: This component manages internationalization and path resolution within the creator goods platform. The specific strings "COMP range" refer to numerical value filters or pricing tiers used when creators set up their digital goods bundles. Translators should treat "COMP" as an abbreviation for "Compensation" or "Completion" depending on the specific bundle configuration type. These labels appear in UI filters where users define ranges for pack settings. Maintain the technical brevity required for dropdown or slider labels. Ensure the distinction between the two keys is clear if they refer to different metrics, such as minimum and maximum range values.
